cause: rank sets the level gate only; imprint also requires the learned set. The three ultimates are complexity 20 and are not domains, so login and rank do not learn them.

evidence.fact: fire_liaoyuan and fire_fentian are MAGIC complexity 20; fire_liaoli is SWORD complexity 20. They are registered.
ReleaseRegistry has all three. They use the plain define factory, not a domain factory.
isUnlocked is true when sword or magic level is at least complexity. Level 20 passes.
offerReady learns only a declared domain with learnsWhenReady.
/shu rank saves the level, calls offerReady, and syncs. It does not learn these three.
The desk lists a technique only when it is both learned and unlocked.
Imprint itself rejects a technique that is not learned or not unlocked.
The client cache stores learned ids separately from the level used by isUnlocked.
